stories.title: Prada opens permanent exhibition in Milan
stories.summary: Prada has opened a permanent exhibition called Pradasphere inside the historic Galleria Vittorio Emanuele in Milan. The space displays archival designs, runway creations, and a spacesuit prototype. The brand says the exhibition offers a deep dive into the history, craftsmanship, and evolution of the fashion house.

stories.summary: Prada’s new Pradasphere exhibition in Milan features archival pieces and a spacesuit prototype. Lorenzo Bertelli, Prada Group's chief marketing officer, called the exhibition a multiplier. stories.title: Bulgari pink diamond sells for $14.6 million
stories.summary: A 24-carat Fancy Intense Pink diamond sold for $14.6 million at a Christie’s sale in Geneva. The stone, known as The Bulgari Pink, had been hidden from the market for over seven decades. It is classified as a Type IIa diamond, a category representing under 2% of natural diamonds.

stories.title: Karnataka promotes handloom heritage
stories.summary: The National Gallery of Modern Art in Bengaluru is hosting a Textiles of Karnataka exhibition to highlight the state's craftsmanship. Karnataka currently accounts for 43 percent of India's mulberry silk production. The state is now attempting to blend these ancient traditions with modern industrial capabilities to reach global markets.

stories.summary: Designer Pawan Sachdevaa says men's fashion in India is shifting away from traditional staples like the kurta and sherwani. stories.summary: Trützschler Group will present fibre processing technologies at India ITME 2026 in Greater Noida this December. The company claims the CPB Knit technology enables salt-free dyeing while reducing water consumption to below one litre per kilogram. The systems are designed for mills processing sportswear, synthetic blends and high-value underwear fabrics.

Exporters are seeking to mitigate risks from changing trade policies.
